summary: Tested ZebraLab v3 fixes: (1) quantity exact multi-up in /api/zpl/generate, (2) batch multi-up packing in /api/batch/generate, (3) agent CORS code review. All 7 backend tests pass. Frontend loads correctly and BatchModal opens.

server.py batch_generate: correctly uses full_strips + remainder logic. qty=3 cols=2 → 1 full strip (2 labels) + 1 partial strip (1 label) = 3 total ✓
zpl_generator.py generate_zpl: quantity param correctly skips cells beyond requested count via `if quantity is not None and cell_index >= quantity: continue` ✓
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes verified: (1) quantity exact multi-up works - quantity=3 with 2x2 gives exactly 3 ^FO elements; (2) batch multi-up packing works - qty=3,cols=2 produces 2 strips (X-Total-Labels=3); (3) agent CORS code review confirms dynamic Origin echo. Previous Permissions-Policy nginx concern from iteration_2 is separate from these fixes.
